comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The one that surprised me most: Poland's Niemcy and Hungary's Nemetorszag go back to a Proto-Slavic root meaning speechless or mute, a label for neighbours whose speech nobody could follow. Lithuania's Vokietija is the loose end, the sources genuinely disagree on it. Everything I used is listed in the description. What does your language call Germany, and does anyone know why?
